name: SRD creature conditions (D&D 2024)
description: The closed, creature-owned D&D 2024 SRD condition instances in canonical order. Each instance records one non-Exhaustion condition and optional source entity identity. It stores no duration, severity, position, condition cause, derived D20 effect, Speed, Hit Points, turn state, or history. Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.conditions. Source: System Reference Document 5.2.1, 'Rules Glossary > Condition', Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0, https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd
